venue_note: Venue criteria and ethics/disclosure policies (USENIX Security, IEEE S&P, CCS, NDSS, ...) must be supplied via rubric.source_file.

criteria.name: Threat model
criteria.description: Attacker goals, knowledge and capabilities are explicit and consistent with the evaluation.

criteria.name: Security evaluation
criteria.description: Attacks and defences are evaluated against adaptive and realistic adversaries.

checks.name: Threat model
questions: Are trust assumptions, attacker goals, knowledge (white/grey/black-box) and capabilities stated explicitly? Are out-of-scope attacks named?

checks.name: Capability consistency
questions: Does the evaluation grant the attacker exactly the stated capabilities (not more for attacks, not less for defences)?

checks.name: Attack coverage vs. defence goals
questions: Do the evaluated attacks cover the defence's stated goals? Are security claims scoped to the evaluated attack classes?

checks.name: Adaptive attackers
questions: For defences (including adversarial-ML defences): is an adaptive attacker that knows the defence evaluated? Any signs of gradient masking or obfuscation?
must_not: Absence of an adaptive attack is a gap in evidence, not proof the defence is broken.

checks.name: Ethics and disclosure
questions: Were vulnerabilities responsibly disclosed? Were human subjects or live systems involved with appropriate approval?
must_not: Do not invent venue policy text.
